method: Project the issuer's Q3 2025 reported segment-revenue-passenger total 48,382,000 by the latest in-quarter UA July passenger ratio 10,768/10,145 to obtain a Q3 2026 mean of 51,353,117 passengers. The certificate-only BTS chart Q3 sums 29,062 in 2025 and 27,447 in 2024 map to issuer totals 48,382 and 45,559 thousand with historical bridge factors 1.66479 and1.65989; preserving that bridge anchors the forecast to the contract's issuer perimeter while avoiding direct summation of regional certificates that may serve several groups. Assume a Normal predictive distribution with this mean and judgemental SD 1,800,000 passengers for missing August/September observations, regional/group mix, revenue-passenger definition differences, and changes in the reporting bridge; July is the latest released month and the SD is deliberately not claimed as empirically estimated. For each strictly-above threshold, use the Normal survival probability at strike plus 500 passengers as a continuity correction for the issuer's thousand-passenger reporting grid.
